stories.story: Mina held a moon atlas, and she wanted to sketch the moon. Jun said, “My whale book is missing.” Mina said, “I promise to help you.” Mina and Jun searched the window nook, but Mina did not find the whale book. Jun saw the star bookmark on the high shelf. Ms Alvarez saved the moon atlas for Mina. Ms Alvarez lifted the whale book down with the ladder. Ms Alvarez gave Jun the whale book. Mina sketched the moon from the moon atlas on the paper. Mina showed Jun the moon drawing.

Jun said, “My whale book is missing.” Mina said, “I promise to help you.” Mina and Jun searched the window nook, but Mina did not find the whale book. Jun spotted the star bookmark on the high shelf. Mina returned the moon atlas to the display table, and Mina chose to help Jun. Ms Alvarez used the ladder to lift the whale book down. Ms Alvarez gave Jun the whale book. Jun said, “You can sketch the whale.” Mina sketched the whale from the whale book on the paper. Mina showed Jun the whale drawing.
